Name: Culprit Reader
Description: Read-only access for the Culprit patch-failure RCA agent. Grants exactly what collection needs (Resource Graph, Activity Log, Log Analytics, and read-only Run Command) and nothing that can change a resource. Phase 1 grants only this role - no Contributor, no Owner, on any scope.
_comment_run_command_action: The DataAction above is what actually invokes Run Command. It is scoped down further at the application layer, not just RBAC: culprit/collectors/guest_linux.py and guest_windows.py hard-code a fixed, reviewed, read-only script - there is no code path in those modules that accepts an arbitrary script to run. culprit/remediation/scripts.py is a second, separate module that deliberately exercises this same already-granted DataAction for one narrow, reviewed, hardcoded write action (disk cleanup) instead - see SECURITY.md's 'Remediation execution' section for the full gate (feature flag, phase2_candidate, a live precision check, a required human confirmation). No additional RBAC grant was made for this; extending either module's allow-listed commands requires a code change and review, not a config change.
_comment_no_write: There is deliberately no Microsoft.Compute/*/write, Microsoft.Maintenance/*/write, or any Contributor-equivalent Action anywhere in this role - that remains true. The one DataAction above is, as of SECURITY.md's 'Remediation execution' section, now also exercised for a narrow guest-level write (disk cleanup via Run Command), not only reads - a deliberate, reviewed, gated exception, not a general write capability: Culprit still cannot change an ARM resource itself under any circumstance, and the one write path it does have requires every condition in that section to hold, every time.
